## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary pivottable row-field value-field chart data-insight >}}

## Step 1 · The total of each group: a PivotTable {.study}

- Rana's sales of one week are a list of 9 rows (made up). She wants **one
  total for each type**.
- **Insert › PivotTable › OK**. Tick the group (**Type**): it goes to
  **Rows**. Tick the number (**Total**): it goes to **Values**.
- Paper 206, Drinks 71, Bags 78 JD. The **Grand Total**: 355 JD.

{{< sim file="sims/excel-lab-pivot.html" poster="sims/excel-lab-pivot.png" title="Excel Lab: a PivotTable of Rana's sales" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · PivotTables"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Rows|Grand Total"}
You tick **Total** (a number). Where does it go?
:   Values

    Why: The numbers go to Values (Sum); the groups go to Rows.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · A chart, and what the data shows {.study}

- Select the types and their totals (not the Grand Total), then **Insert ›
  Column › Clustered Column**. Click **Chart Title** and type a title.
- The tallest column is the biggest group: Paper, 206 of 355 JD, more than
  half of the money.

{{< sim file="sims/excel-lab-pivotchart.html" poster="sims/excel-lab-pivotchart.png" title="Excel Lab: a chart of the totals" height="640" >}}

## Step 3 · AI can add a total {.study}

Only look and try here: the tasks do not need AI.

- On **tutudocs.com** (no sign-in) open the sheet, then **AI Assistant**.
- Ask for one change, for example a **Total** row at the end.
- **File › Download**, the Excel file (**.xlsx**).

{{< sim file="sims/tutu-online.html" poster="sims/tutu-online.png" title="Tutu Lab: AI adds a total to your sheet" height="700" >}}
